about.title: About me
about.intro: I'm Wilson Javier Simbaña Ganazhapa, a game programmer with a background in Computer Engineering and a Master's degree in Game Development.
about.description: I am particularly interested in gameplay programming and the development of interactive systems. I have worked with Unreal Engine 5, implementing ability systems using the Gameplay Ability System (GAS), animation systems, build automation tools, and shaders. I have also developed features in Unity, including character movement, camera systems, and HUD interfaces.
about.description2: Additionally, my experience in software development using technologies such as Angular and .NET has allowed me to expand my programming knowledge and understanding of application architecture.
